sc.panel: Calculates the time to reach next SE or a specific goal.
sc.battery1: Battery cost can be found in the SE menu.
sc.current: Current DC can be found in the SR and SE menus.
sc.gain: DC output can be found in the SR menu.
sc.time: Time in current SE can be found in the SE menu.
sc.replicator_dc:
DC replicator can be found in the SR menu.
You may need to set the value manually because of the retain mechanic.
sc.replicator_sc:
SE replicator can be found in the SE menu.
You may need to set the value manually because of the retain mechanic.
sc.onlineBonus:
First 10 online hours add 38 skip minutes each hour.
Alpha Supplies increases this online bonus by 1% per level.
sc.timeskip: Time skips are inefficient for SE progression because they don't affect replicators.
sc.future: Customs boost can be used include any future boosts that you will get during the run.
sc.refresh:
Refreshes elapsed Time in SE since your last manual time edit.
Replicators update inputs automatically.
penrose.panel: Track current status, next cycle goal, and ETA based on your cycle pace.
penrose.status: Current cycle status in Penrose progression.
penrose.cycleRate: Average cycles progressed per hour during your current run.
og.panel: Input your run state and compare the highest-value OG upgrades.
og.calculationMode:
Mode affects how techs are valued.
Juno mode only considers Juno gain.
DC mode also considers DC gain.
og.junoOutputLevel: Each level adds 2% additive premium boost.
og.junoTokens: Token amount contributes to your premium multiplier.
og.zagreusCycles:
Zagreus significantly affects tech values.
Higher cycle levels make cheaper techs more valuable.
og.sharesPercent: Shares percent converted to guide share amount at 0.05 per unit.
og.exponent:
Juno exponent slightly affects tech values.
It also reduces the relative value of exponent boosts.
og.extraExponent:
Exponent can be manually adjusted if needed.
For example when some boost is missing from this site.
og.premium:
Shop upgrades are applied outside the exponent.
These reduce the relative value of exponent boosts.
cruise.panel: Input cruise run values, compare node value per point, and apply best-upgrade actions.
cruise.level: Current cruise level from the Cruise Ship tab. Affects Particle Output and Echo unlock/value.
cruise.ticketPrice: Ticket price from the Overview page.
cruise.guestSpending:
Minimum and maximum guest spending from the Overview page.
Evaluation uses the average value.
cruise.roomCapacity:
Minimum and maximum room capacity from the Overview page.
Evaluation uses the average value.
cruise.sunUpgrades: Sun upgrade levels needed to estimate base room capacity before prestige-node effects.
cruise.groupsDiscount:
Groups Discount level from Sun Upgrades.
Each level increases room capacity by 1.08x.
cruise.bunkBeds:
Bunk Beds level from Sun Upgrades.
Each level increases room capacity by 1.05x.
cruise.notation:
Prestige notation uses node levels separated by '/'.
Order is left to right in the Prestige Upgrades menu.
factory.panel: Input Factory run values, compare node value per point, and apply best-upgrade actions.
factory.particleLevel:
Total particle level from the Prestige tab.
Used by Particle Output evaluation.
factory.notation:
Prestige notation uses node levels separated by '/'.
Order is left to right in the Prestige Upgrades menu.
factory.weights: Adjust how much Production and Particle upgrades are valued compared to Sell Value.
factoryProduction.panel: Configure manufacturers and resource outputs to estimate production, profit, and resource balance.
factoryProduction.pricing: Apply upgrades and multipliers that affect final sell price.
factoryProduction.shifts: From Upgrades tab. Adds +1 additive base sell price when enabled.
factoryProduction.qualityControl: From Upgrades tab. Adds +10 additive base sell price per level (max 20).
factoryProduction.globalMultiplier: From Stats. Multiplies sell price for all products.
factoryProduction.categoryMultiplier: From Stats. Multiplies sell price for this category.
premium.panelCrystalToken: Chest and bot output with premium upgrades.
premium.panelHaulerMine: Layer income by time with premium toggles.
premium.supplyBotTokenUpgrade: In the Token Shop under Supplies Upgrades. Gives +0.1 token per level.
premium.supplyBotCrystalUpgrade: In the Token Shop under Supplies Upgrades. Gives +1 crystal per level.
premium.bbDurationUpgrade: In the Token Shop under BB-Bot Upgrades. Adds 60 seconds and +0.05 tokens per level.
premium.bbTokenUpgrade: In the Token Shop under BB-Bot Upgrades. Requires BB-Bot Duration level 40 and adds 0.5 tokens per level.
premium.tokenBooster: In the Crystal Shop special upgrades tab. Adds 1% token gain per level to all token sources.
premium.chestEnhancer: In the Gamma Corporation module collection. Gives +10% chest tokens per level.
premium.averageHoursPerDay: How many hours per day you actively collect with optimal timing.
premium.seItem: Selected SE threshold for daily token reward multiplier.
premium.includeDailyRewards: Adds 100 crystals and 34.375 tokens daily, then applies token booster and selected SE multiplier to the token part.
premium.luckyLeafClover: Reduces chest cooldown by 10% for Basic and Rare chest cycles.
premium.unlockedLayers: Highest unlocked layer in the hauler mine route.
premium.haulerTokenBooster: Shared with Crystal and Token tab. Applies to all hauler token rewards.
perkGuide.panel: SE-based perk recommendations with change notes and mobile-friendly layout.
zatGuide.panel:
ZAT node recommendations for various runs.
Shows total boosts.
credits.panel: Contributors, references, and acknowledgements from data/credits.json.
